# Draft:Four (Battle for Dream Island)

Four is a character created by Michael and Cary Huang from the channel jacknjellify on YouTube. Four was created for a school project, but eventually returned in the duo's web series, Battle for Dream Island. Four serves as the channel's mascot and a major character in most videos after their introduction on the show in 2017.
Appearances
X Finds Out His Value
Four first appeared in "X Finds Out His Value" and is one of many anthropomorphic algebraic symbols (mostly numbers) called algebraliens. While the other numbers play in the Equation Playground, Four finds their friend X upset because X does not know his numerical value. Throughout the video, Four and X solve an equation on a balance beam to figure out what X equals, which is revealed to be 7. This short animation was created for a school project.
Battle for Dream Island
Four makes their debut in the 4th season (Battle for B.F.D.I., abbreviated as BFB) of Battle for Dream Island, in which they, as the main host, offer a BFDI as the prize; a physical form of all of the episodes of the first season. In BFB, Four differs greatly from their old self; tormenting others and being very surreal and poorly drawn. The season later splits into two other seasons; Battle for B.F.B. (a continuation of season 4) and The Power of Two (a new 5th season of BFDI where a different algebralien, Two, offers his power as a prize). Four is kinder and dimmed down in the BFB continuation, and at the end, they learn to not treat their contestants terribly. In TPOT, Four remains antagonizing at times, but plays an antihero role against One, the season's main antagonist. Four hosts and co-hosts TPOT at times, such as in TPOT 6 and 16.
Reception and impact
Four received most of their fame from BFDI when he was added. They are loved for their comical appearance and behavior. Four's status as the host of BFB also boosted their own popularity greatly. Four is less favorably received in Battle for B.F.B. for being "whiny" and "annoying" but is still quite popular. Four's popularity continues in TPOT, where they make many appearances and gain more of an important role.
Four left a significant impact on Battle for Dream Island alongside prominent algebralien characters such as One and Two. Four also became the mascot for jacknjellify alongside their friend and co-host X. The first theatrically-released episode of Battle for Dream Island, "Alone", about the backstory of the algebraliens, resulted in Four's popularity increasing due to their role in the episode.
